title: Scalar tensor section and the sheafification unit
statement: On a site satisfying the SystemScalarModel sheafification and smallness assumptions, fix phi:R→S and a DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel D for phi. For every R-module sheaf N, object U, scalar s in S(U) and x in N(U), transporting the sheafification of s tensor x through the inverse model object equality gives exactly systemModelTmul D N U s x. The definitions and hypotheses are as in [def-weil-pbc-system-scalar-model], [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].

source.place: Tags 03D7 and 03EK; sites-cohomology.tex 06YY. Exact proof previously private in IntegralComparisonSequenceSystems.

proof.text:
Write the sheafification unit explicitly. Both the unit and the transport by the object
equality are linear. Move the scalar through these two linear maps; multiplication by scalar s
sends one tensor x to s tensor x in the balanced tensor product.

lean.statement:
theorem modelTmul_eq
    {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{sw}} (φ : R ⟶ S)
    (D : SheafOfModules.DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel φ)
    (N : SheafOfModules.{sw} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))
    (U : Cᵒᵖ) (s : S.obj.obj U) (x : N.val.obj U) :
    (eqToHom (D.obj_eq N).symm).val.app U
      ((toSheafify J (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf φ N).presheaf).app U
        (s ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj U, (φ.hom.app U).hom] x)) =
      SheafOfModules.systemModelTmul D N U s x
